short_description: LifeStance Health is one of the largest outpatient mental health providers in the US with 550+ locations across 33 states, offering therapy and psychiatry.
long_description: LifeStance Health is one of the largest outpatient mental health companies in the United States, operating over 550 centers across 33 states with 7,400+ clinicians including psychiatrists, psychologists, and therapists. For patients, LifeStance offers convenient access to mental health care with both in-person visits and telehealth options. The company accepts most major commercial insurance plans for therapy, psychiatry, and medication management services. LifeStance treats anxiety, depression, ADHD, bipolar disorder, and other conditions across the lifespan including children, teens, and adults. Appointments can typically be scheduled within 1-2 weeks. The large clinic network means many patients can find a local LifeStance location for in-person care when preferred.
patient_summary: LifeStance Health has 550+ mental health clinics across 33 states offering therapy and psychiatry. Both in-person and video appointments available. Most commercial insurance accepted.

pricing.notes: Accepts most commercial insurance plans. Copays typically $20-60/session depending on plan. Self-pay rates available.

privacy.notes: HIPAA compliant healthcare provider. Medical records protected by HIPAA regulations.

faqs.q: Does LifeStance Health accept my insurance?
faqs.a: LifeStance accepts most major commercial insurance plans including Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, United Healthcare, and many others. Coverage varies by location and plan. Contact your local LifeStance office or check their website to verify your specific insurance is accepted.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get an appointment at LifeStance?
faqs.a: Most patients can schedule appointments within 1-2 weeks, faster than many traditional practices. Wait times vary by location, clinician specialty, and appointment type. New patient evaluations may have longer wait times than follow-ups.

faqs.q: Does LifeStance offer both in-person and virtual appointments?
faqs.a: Yes, LifeStance offers both in-person appointments at their 550+ clinic locations and telehealth video appointments. Many patients use a hybrid approach—some sessions in-person, others virtual. Virtual availability depends on your state and provider licensing.

LifeStance treats anxiety, depression, ADHD, bipolar disorder, PTSD, OCD, eating disorders, and other mental health conditions. Services include therapy, psychiatry, and medication management for children, teens, and adults. Specialty services vary by location.
